name: United States federal
summary: U.S. federal peptide regulation is split among FDA approval, compounding exemptions under FD&C Act sections 503A and 503B, drug-shortage authorities, enforcement discretion, and (for sport) WADA rules.
scope_notes: Federal law preempts certain state requirements for approved drugs but leaves much compounding oversight to state boards of pharmacy. This page covers FDA, DEA, FTC, and WADA sport-rule status only.
